title: Recorded engineering benchmarks
purpose: Index original measurements with their hardware and provenance limits.
summary: Original benchmark JSON is preserved byte-for-byte. PASS indicates retained engineering evidence, not trained model capability or current hardware readiness.
methodology: Original synthetic-token benchmarks use real forward/backward/AdamW updates, synchronized CUDA timing and BF16 autocast where supported.
Original hardware scope: RTX 4080, Python 3.13.14, PyTorch 2.11.0+cu130; inspect each JSON for its precise configuration.
results: Context, dashboard, smoke and primary measurements remain individually inspectable in evidence/.
limitations: Exact executed dirty-source identities were not captured for early measurements; the foundation commit is only an associated snapshot.
Peak allocated memory excludes driver/context and reserved memory. Short-run extrapolations exclude validation, checkpoint and sustained-load effects.
No measurements were rerun or fabricated during repository organization.
next_actions: Use original JSON for configuration-specific values.
Collect a new explicitly bounded measurement with source/config/environment provenance before claiming a performance change.
takeaway: Nine original engineering records retain their measured hardware and workload scope.
